scope.cohort_basis: The same assessment units present in the captured 2022 layer; earlier ratings are original columns on those current records.
scope.size_basis: AU_Length and AU_Units are the source's fixed 2022 published size. Size-weighted groupings use that fixed corpus, not reconstructed historical lengths or areas.
scope.rating_interpretation: Preserve each original publisher rating verbatim. No Data is an assessment label; null remains missing. Rating changes do not establish a causal or measured water-quality trend.
scope.geometry_basis: No historical geometry is reconstructed. The 34 polygon records are alternate geometries for units in this corpus and are not additional assessment units.
scope.parameter_table_basis: The separate parameter table's 2022 and 2020 CYCLE rows are not these eight overall-rating columns.
scope.classification_basis: BIMS_CLASS and PRIMARY_CLASS are retained current source attributes, not inferred historical legal classifications.
